newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans up sharply on bull spreads, China.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans up sharply on bull spreads, China.

text.p: CBOT nearby soybean contracts rallied in fast trade Thursday on bull spreading and talk that China was seeking U.S. soybeans, traders said.
"There's lots of talk that China is buying old crop beans," said one floor trader.
Rumors circulated in the market that China overnight purchased as much as 100,000 tonnes of soybeans for prompt shipment and were seeking 200,000 more, traders said.
However, U.S. exporters could not confirm such trades.
July and August soybeans were also boosted by ideas that Wednesday's limit-down losses were overdone, traders said.
"July took a big hit yesterday and now it's coming back," said one floor trader.
At 1207 CDT, CBOT soybeans were 1/2 to eight cents per bushel higher with July up eight at $8.38 per bushel.
